description: Originally a prototype gunship design for the Colonial Minutemen, the predecessor to the Pyxis faced many issues making it undesirable, such as rampant overheating and in-atmosphere crashes due to an oversized gun mount. The design was swiftly denied by the Minutemen, and with Lanchester Shipyards not wanting to cut losses, swiftly began to cut out most sensitive internals and began extensive refitting of the prototype. Now, the modern Pyxis-class is a modular civilian hullform, ranging from fast policing shuttles to mobile ambulances to transport and tend to wounded.
